content.short: HyperDash is a trading terminal for Hyperliquid with real-time analytics and portfolio tracking.
content.description: HyperDash is a dedicated terminal for traders on Hyperliquid, built around the perpetuals order book rather than spot markets. It combines live market analytics, position and portfolio tracking, and views into vault and whale activity that the native interface does not surface directly. It suits traders who want more context on positioning and flow than an exchange front end typically provides.
content.meta: HyperDash is a Hyperliquid trading terminal offering real-time perps analytics and portfolio tracking.
